column1: # Tools installed by windows/restore-config.ps1 (-Installs) and linux/restore-config.sh (--packages).
# One row per tool, TAB-separated. "-" means "not on this platform" (empty cells
# can't be used: bash collapses runs of tabs).
#   check    comma-separated commands; if any is on PATH the tool counts as installed.
#            Entries containing "\" are Windows paths (%VAR% expanded), for apps
#            that don't put an exe on PATH.
#   version  exact version to install (and pin on Windows); "-" = latest
#   dnf      Fedora / RHEL package name(s), space-separated
#   apt      Ubuntu / Debian package name(s), space-separated
#   linux    custom Linux installer in linux/restore-config.sh, used instead of dnf/apt
# PowerToys (option 10) and ffmpeg on Windows (option 9) have their own sections.
# AutoHotkey v1 isn't a separate winget package: -Installs adds it next to v2
